notes: Printed below the table: 'Source: Guideline and Manual for Planning and Design in Japan, JSWA, 2009', with JSWA in italics.

The two right-hand columns carry no headings of their own: the middle column names one or more processes or ratios and the last column prints the matching rates on the same printed lines. Each printed line pair is kept inside one cell with the printed line breaks.
